statement: The full horizontal intrinsic class-two obstruction over the actual B0 relative value, all six liftable coordinates, and the complete varying joint image with all geometric-conjugacy fibres.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The actual B0 norm origin is retained, while the entire horizontal lattice V is allowed. Its complete obstruction is [7[v,e_B0]] with image C3^2 x C9 and exact three residue conditions modulo3,3,9.

The liftable horizontal cohomology is free of rank6. Six literal integral representatives and a six-by-ten inverse on the proved solution lattice give all coordinates, including every preimage outside K1.
The relative correction is an explicit six-column combination of actual Hall brackets. Exact Z_(3) identities give its source defect and joint image (m/4,-m/4).

The genuine character theta=n+nprime+p(p-1) of J2, its actual arithmetic intertwiners and known cusp values leave one handle-marking coefficient. All three possibilities have the same value2m on the complete liftable locus; no uncomputed handle coefficient is substituted.

The entire joint image has coordinates L,m,rho,sigma in Z3, with relative central mean3sigma and horizontal central mean residue m modulo3. Its full fixed geometric gauge and all finite carries are displayed.
The complete source locus is Z3^52 x C3^9 x C9^5. Every joint-image point has fibre Z3^48 x C3^9 x C9^5, including the four extra horizontal coordinates and all E85 central-kernel coordinates.
The actual Hall image is evaluated before the literal E85 right inverse is used to normalize it. The lower aligning conjugator and all nonlinear central corrections are retained.
Other relative abelian values and the original global section fibres remain separate tasks; E23 is not declared solved.
Independent root audit: the entire proof and program were read; all seven input hashes were checked; the fresh source/JSON/stdout are byte-identical, with no excluded fields. PASS.
